coda.title: The Flame Wavers
coda.d01: Aurelia sleeps. In the Temple, the flame of Vesta burns as it has burned for a thousand years.
coda.d02: Then, with no wind at all, it bends until it almost touches the stone.
coda.d03: For a moment, all across the city, every thread tangles in another. A man forgets his sentence halfway. A dog howls at the ground. Beneath the Temple, something enormous wakes.
coda.d04: And it passes. In the morning, no one speaks of it.
coda.d05: Far below, in the chamber of three portals, the smooth stone of the third one cracks. A crack as fine as a thread.
